description: Build a Shopify cart permalink on armornglory.com for one or more product variants (variant IDs come from search or product details). Opens a pre-filled cart so the shopper can review and pay on ArmorNGlory.com. Only pass a discount code the user actually provided.

attributes.description: Optional custom key-value cart attributes for order tracking (e.g. { source: 'mcp_agent', intent: 'easter_gift' })

discountCode.description: Optional discount code to apply at checkout (e.g. SAVED10)

items.description: List of items to add to checkout

note.description: Optional order note or special instruction for Shopify Admin (e.g. 'Curated by AI Stylist')

name: generate_direct_checkout_link
